description.value: Guildford Station Pub is a neighbourhood pub and sports bar in Surrey's Guildford area, also operating an attached liquor store. Described on its own website as a 'hidden gem' and cozy social hub, it offers a broad menu of pub classics, wings, tacos, and cocktails alongside a well-stocked tap list of BC craft and mainstream beers. Minors are not permitted inside the pub.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the OSM address (10176-154 Street Surrey BC V3R4J6) and phone (604-582-2800). The about page describes the pub as a cozy social hub for locals with casual meals and drinks, and the header consistently names it 'Guildford Station Pub and Liquor store' — slightly different from the OSM name. The food menu includes the text 'Vegetarian' as a label within the item list (appearing between Deep Fried Pickles and Dry Garlic Ribs entries), indicating at least some vegetarian items are identified on the menu. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, takeout, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Website header and about page consistently name the business 'Guildford Station Pub and Liquor store', which differs from the OSM name 'Guildford Station Pub' — the liquor store component is not reflected in the OSM record.
No Minors policy explicitly stated on every page — relevant for cyclists travelling with children.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pub with a live website, confirmed contact details, and a full food and drink menu — a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal or cold drink in Surrey.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Food menu labels at least one item as 'Vegetarian' (appears as a dietary label within the appetizers section, associated with Deep Fried Pickles)

wow_evidence: neighbourhood pub and sports bar in Surrey's Guildford area
